note: CDC/ATSDR SVI 2022 (ACS 2018-2022), layer "SVI2022 PR tract", 939 tracts; -999 = no data, left out. Tract poverty_pct = EP_POV150 (below 150% of poverty). County layer "SVI2022 PR municipio" gives official values for 78 municipios. Where no official county row exists, municipio values are aggregated from tracts: population, housing_units, households = sums of E_TOTPOP, E_HU, E_HH; svi_overall, poverty150_pct, age65_pct, disability_pct, no_health_insurance_pct = E_TOTPOP-weighted means of the tract values; no_vehicle_pct and crowding_pct = E_HH-weighted; mobile_home_pct = E_HU-weighted. svi_basis on each municipio says which applies.
